notes.title: A Fresh Puzzles Challenge Awaits!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to announce a new update for the game, bringing fresh content! The numbers for the puzzle in the library are now randomized, adding an extra layer of challenge. To uncover the correct sequence, a brand-new puzzle has been introduced to guide you to the answer.

We hope you enjoy the update!

Thank you,
The Intetic Team

notes.title: Exciting New Content Together With Winter Sale
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’re happy to announce that together with Winter Sale 2024, we’ve added 3 new puzzles to enhance the gameplay experience of "The Strange Story of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2"! These additional challenges are designed to bring even more intrigue and enjoyment to your journey through Brian Fisher’s mysterious world.

We hope you love this new content as much as we enjoyed creating it. Rest assured, we are committed to taking care of the game based on your feedback and will continue to respond to your requests as best as we can.

Thank you for supporting us on this adventure.

Thank you,
Intetic Team

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
We’re pleased to share that "The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2" is compatible with Steam Deck. This allows players to enjoy the game on the go or from the comfort of their home with the convenience of this handheld device. The experience remains consistent, offering the same puzzles, story, and visuals as the PC version.

Whether at home or traveling, Steam Deck provides another way to experience Brian’s journey in a portable format.

notes.title: Chapter 2 is Available Now!!!
notes.content:
The wait is over! "The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2" is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam! Dive in and start unraveling the mystery behind Brian Fisher’s journey. Get ready to challenge your mind, explore captivating environments, think out of the box, and uncover the secrets waiting for you. Let the adventure begin!

notes.content:

notes.title: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2 | Teaser 4
The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2 | Teaser 3
The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2 | Teaser 2
Continue Brian Fisher's Enigmatic Journey: Chapter 2 New Teaser Trailer
notes.content:
Respected Players,

We are thrilled to present the new teaser trailer for "The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2"! Following the release of Chapter 1, we're excited to continue Brian Fisher's enigmatic journey.

[previewyoutube=5RKnF_WtsbI;full][/previewyoutube]

In this teaser, you see a snippet from Chapter 1, where our main character falls unconscious, and then transitions to Chapter 2, where he wakes up 30 years earlier as a 9-year-old boy. Witness the intriguing start of his new adventure and get a taste of the gameplay that awaits in Chapter 2.

Stay tuned for more updates and announcing the official release date that is very close. In the meantime, enjoy the trailer and prepare for the next chapter in Brian Fisher's strange story!

Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682400/The_Strange_Story_Of_Brian_Fisher_Chapter_2/

With Respect,
Intetic Team

notes.title: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2 and Demo
notes.content:
Respected Players,

We are happy to announce that we set a release period for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682400/The_Strange_Story_Of_Brian_Fisher_Chapter_2/]The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2[/url] to Q4/2021. We know that it took time, but we have to say that we were affected by the Covid-19 situation, and our development at some point was almost 0%. Now we are back and hope we will speed up the process.

Also, we released a small demo version that you can download from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682400/The_Strange_Story_Of_Brian_Fisher_Chapter_2/]Chapter 2 Steam page[/url].

[previewyoutube=Sc1jeB8WhTs;full][/previewyoutube]

Please send us any feedback, critic, review that you have. On that way we can improve our current chapter, previous chapter and next chapters.

Thank you for all your support.

Have fun,
Intetic Team
